svg.desc: Racket Point · v4.2 · 29 July 2026 · Extracted mark (the octagonal O with centred dot). True vector paths, no font dependency. Construction: 64-unit box, octagon inscribed at radius 26, stroke 6, round joins, centre dot r 8.5; favicon cut uses stroke 9 and dot r 11, 16px use only. Verified against the v4.2 correction: the standalone mark is centred in its own box by construction and is independent of wordmark baseline alignment — geometry unchanged.
